title: Queue Simulation
description: Simulate a single-server queue, explain event timing, and compare service scenarios with operational metrics.

zh-Hant.title: 排隊系統模擬
zh-Hant.description: 模擬單一服務台排隊系統、解釋事件時間，並以營運指標比較不同服務情境。

artifacts.label: Queue Event Timeline
artifacts.alt: Timeline showing customer arrivals, service starts, and service completions in a single-server queue
artifacts.caption: The event timeline exposes when customers wait, when the server is busy, and when idle capacity appears.

zh-Hant.label: 排隊事件時間軸
zh-Hant.alt: 顯示單一服務台中顧客抵達、開始服務與完成服務時間的時間軸
zh-Hant.caption: 事件時間軸呈現顧客何時等候、服務台何時忙碌，以及何時出現閒置產能。

artifacts.label: Waiting-time Distribution
artifacts.alt: Histogram showing the distribution of simulated customer waiting times
artifacts.caption: The tail of the distribution reveals customer experiences that an average waiting time can hide.

zh-Hant.label: 等候時間分布
zh-Hant.alt: 顯示模擬顧客等候時間分布的直方圖
zh-Hant.caption: 分布尾端可揭示平均等候時間可能掩蓋的顧客體驗。

artifacts.label: Queue Scenario Comparison
artifacts.alt: Chart comparing waiting time and utilization across queue service scenarios
artifacts.caption: Scenario comparison makes the trade-off between shorter waits and higher resource utilization visible.

zh-Hant.label: 排隊情境比較
zh-Hant.alt: 比較不同排隊服務情境之等候時間與使用率的圖表
zh-Hant.caption: 情境比較可呈現縮短等候時間與提高資源使用率之間的取捨。

artifacts.label: Running Average of Waiting Time
artifacts.alt: Line chart showing how the cumulative average waiting time changes as more customers are simulated
artifacts.caption: A settling running average provides evidence that the simulation horizon is long enough for a stable estimate.

zh-Hant.label: 等候時間移動累計平均
zh-Hant.alt: 顯示隨模擬顧客數增加，累計平均等候時間如何變化的折線圖
zh-Hant.caption: 逐漸穩定的累計平均可支持模擬期間足以產生穩定估計的判斷。

sections.title: Code Case Overview
sections.summary: Connect customer experience, queue congestion, and server utilization in one simulation.

zh-Hant.title: 程式碼案例概覽
zh-Hant.summary: 在同一模擬中串連顧客體驗、排隊壅塞與服務台使用率。

blocks.title: Translate random events into operational decisions
paragraphs: This code case models customers arriving randomly at a single server and records when each customer begins and completes service.
The published indicators describe both typical performance and difficult tail cases, helping connect simulation mechanics with capacity decisions.

zh-Hant.title: 將隨機事件轉化為營運決策
paragraphs: 此程式碼案例模擬顧客隨機抵達單一服務台，並記錄每位顧客開始與完成服務的時間。
發布的指標同時描述典型表現與較極端的尾端情況，協助把模擬機制連結到產能決策。

items.label: Mean wait
items.detail: Average time spent waiting before service

zh-Hant.label: 平均等候時間
zh-Hant.detail: 開始服務前的平均等候時間

items.label: 95th-percentile wait
items.detail: A tail measure of the customer waiting experience

zh-Hant.label: 第 95 百分位等候時間
zh-Hant.detail: 反映顧客等候體驗尾端的指標

items.label: Utilization
items.detail: Share of simulated time when the server is busy

zh-Hant.label: 服務台使用率
zh-Hant.detail: 模擬期間服務台處於忙碌狀態的比例

items.label: Probability of waiting
items.detail: Share of customers who do not receive immediate service

zh-Hant.label: 需要等候的機率
zh-Hant.detail: 未能立即接受服務的顧客比例

items.label: Maximum queue
items.detail: Largest observed number of waiting customers

zh-Hant.label: 最大排隊人數
zh-Hant.detail: 觀察到的最大等候顧客數

blocks.title: Average performance is only one view
blocks.content: A system with an acceptable mean wait can still produce long delays for a smaller group of customers. Read the mean and the 95th percentile together.

zh-Hant.title: 平均表現只是其中一個視角
zh-Hant.content: 平均等候時間可接受的系統，仍可能讓少數顧客經歷很長延誤；應同時解讀平均值與第 95 百分位。

sections.title: Simulate Queue Events
sections.summary: Follow arrival, service-start, and departure times through the single-server recurrence.

zh-Hant.title: 模擬排隊事件
zh-Hant.summary: 沿著單一服務台的遞迴關係，追蹤抵達、開始服務與離開時間。

items.title: Generate an arrival
items.content: Add a sampled interarrival time to determine when the next customer enters the system.

zh-Hant.title: 生成抵達事件
zh-Hant.content: 累加抽樣得到的抵達間隔，決定下一位顧客進入系統的時間。

items.title: Start service when possible
items.content: Service begins at the later of the customer arrival and the previous service completion.

zh-Hant.title: 在可用時開始服務
zh-Hant.content: 開始服務時間取顧客抵達與上一位完成服務兩者中的較晚時間。

items.title: Record the departure
items.content: Add the sampled service time and retain waiting, queue, and busy-time statistics.

zh-Hant.title: 記錄離開事件
zh-Hant.content: 加上抽樣的服務時間，並保存等候、隊列與忙碌時間統計。

sections.title: Inspect Waiting Times
sections.summary: Move beyond the mean and examine the shape and tail of customer delays.

zh-Hant.title: 檢視等候時間
zh-Hant.summary: 超越平均值，檢視顧客延誤的分布形狀與尾端。

blocks.title: Why the distribution is usually skewed
paragraphs: Many customers may receive immediate or short service, while a burst of arrivals creates a much smaller group with long waits.
This asymmetry is why percentiles and the full distribution are useful companions to the mean.

zh-Hant.title: 為何分布通常呈現偏斜
paragraphs: 許多顧客可能立即或很快接受服務，但一波密集抵達會使少數顧客經歷長時間等候。
這種不對稱正是百分位數與完整分布應搭配平均值解讀的原因。

blocks.title: Check units before comparison
blocks.content: Arrival rates, service rates, waiting times, and plot axes must use a consistent time unit.

zh-Hant.title: 比較前先確認單位
zh-Hant.content: 抵達率、服務率、等候時間與圖表座標軸必須使用一致的時間單位。

sections.title: Compare Service Scenarios
sections.summary: Change demand and service capacity, then compare customer delay with resource utilization.

zh-Hant.title: 比較服務情境
zh-Hant.summary: 改變需求與服務能力，再比較顧客延誤與資源使用率。

blocks.title: Scenario benchmark
blocks.description: Each row is a complete simulation under a different arrival or service assumption.

zh-Hant.title: 情境效能比較
zh-Hant.description: 每一列代表在不同抵達或服務假設下完成的一次模擬。

blocks.title: Capacity has a nonlinear effect
blocks.content: When demand approaches service capacity, a small rate change can create a disproportionately large change in waiting time.

zh-Hant.title: 產能影響具有非線性
zh-Hant.content: 當需求接近服務能力時，速率的微小變化可能造成不成比例的大幅等候時間變化。

sections.title: Check Simulation Convergence
sections.summary: Use the running average to judge whether the simulated sample is long enough for interpretation.

zh-Hant.title: 檢查模擬收斂
zh-Hant.summary: 利用累計平均判斷模擬樣本是否足夠長，能支持結果解讀。

blocks.title: Look for stability, not a perfectly flat line
blocks.content: Random simulation output continues to fluctuate. The useful question is whether later observations change the cumulative estimate materially.

zh-Hant.title: 尋找穩定趨勢，而非完全水平的線
zh-Hant.content: 隨機模擬輸出仍會持續波動；真正要判斷的是後續觀測是否仍會明顯改變累計估計。

zh-Hant.title: 視覺化事件、分布與收斂情形

sections.title: Trace the Source Code
sections.summary: Connect orchestration, queue mechanics, published metrics, and visualization helpers.

zh-Hant.title: 追蹤原始程式碼
zh-Hant.summary: 串連流程協調、排隊機制、發布指標與視覺化輔助函式。

blocks.title: Separate the simulation engine from presentation
paragraphs: The main function defines scenarios and publishes outputs, while the simulator focuses only on event timing and queue statistics.
The plotting helper consumes returned results without changing the simulated data, keeping analysis and presentation responsibilities distinct.

zh-Hant.title: 分離模擬引擎與呈現層
paragraphs: 主函式定義情境並發布輸出，模擬器則只專注於事件時間與排隊統計。
繪圖輔助函式讀取回傳結果而不修改模擬資料，使分析與呈現職責保持分離。
